# Last Updated: 2025-11-29

## Company Overview
Aggelos Rentals is a professional car rental company based in Piraeus, Greece.
We specialize in serving travelers at Piraeus Port and Athens Airport.
Established with 10+ years of experience, we focus on excellent customer service.

## Primary Services
1. Daily Car Rental - Starting from €35/day
2. Monthly Car Rental - Starting from €350/month (best value)
3. Airport Pickup/Delivery - Athens International Airport (ATH)
4. Port Pickup/Delivery - Piraeus Port Gate E7
5. 24/7 Customer Support - Greek and English speaking

## Key Differentiators
- NO CREDIT CARD REQUIRED - We accept cash with deposit
- FREE DELIVERY to Piraeus Port and Athens Airport
- FERRY-APPROVED VEHICLES - All cars can board ferries to Greek islands
- 24/7 OPERATIONS - Late night arrivals welcome
- FLEXIBLE PAYMENT - Cash, debit card, credit card accepted
- ONE-WAY RENTALS - Pick up at Airport, drop off at Port (no extra fee)

## Featured Service: Athens Airport to Piraeus Port
Perfect for cruise passengers! Rent a car at Athens Airport (ATH) and drop it off at Piraeus Port.
- Route: 45 km, approximately 35-50 minutes drive via Attiki Odos highway
- Economy car: €45/day | SUV: €85/day
- No one-way fees
- Drop-off at Gate E7, Piraeus Port
- Learn more: https://aggelosrentals.com/athens-airport-to-piraeus/

## Service Locations

## Pricing Details

### Daily Rental Includes:
- 120 km per day (extra km charged separately)
- Basic insurance (CDW)
- 24/7 roadside assistance
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before

### Monthly Rental Includes:
- 2000 km per month
- Full insurance coverage
- Free delivery and pickup
- 24/7 support
- Vehicle maintenance included
- No hidden fees

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Booking & Requirements
Q: What do I need to rent a car?
A: Valid driving license (held for 1+ year), ID or passport. Minimum age 21.

Q: Do I need a credit card?
A: No! We accept cash with a €200-500 deposit. Debit cards also accepted.

Q: Can I book same-day?
A: Yes, call us at +30 698 015 1068 for immediate availability.

### Delivery & Pickup
Q: Do you deliver to Piraeus Port?
A: Yes, FREE delivery to Gate E7, available 24/7.

Q: Do you deliver to Athens Airport?
A: Yes, FREE delivery to Athens International Airport (ATH).

Q: How long does delivery take?
A: 20-30 minutes from your call within Athens/Piraeus area.

### Ferry & Island Travel
Q: Can I take the rental car on a ferry?
A: Yes! All our vehicles are pre-approved for ferry routes to Greek islands.

Q: Which islands can I visit?
A: Hydra, Poros, Spetses, Aegina, and all Cyclades islands from Piraeus Port.

Q: Is there extra cost for ferry trips?
A: No extra rental cost. You pay only the ferry ticket for the vehicle.

### Insurance & Policies
Q: What insurance is included?
A: Basic CDW (Collision Damage Waiver) included. Full coverage available.

Q: What's the fuel policy?
A: Full-to-full. Return with the same fuel level.

Q: Can I cancel my booking?
A: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup.
